ocr.mdd: Let me pull the text out of that picture.
ocr.route.pdfHasText: If the PDF already has text, a dedicated tool extracts it more accurately.
ocr.route.unsupported: That kind of file is not handled — give a photo or a PDF
ocr.status.pdf: Send PDFs to the dedicated tool above (for a scanned PDF, export the page as an image first)
ocr.status.badImage: Could not read that as an image
ocr.status.noModel: {language} cannot be read by this tool yet — we will not pretend otherwise
ocr.status.noGpu: This browser cannot run the local AI (no WebGPU)
ocr.status.downloading: Downloading the reading model… (about {mb}MB, only when you turn it on)
ocr.status.empty: No text found — a larger, brighter photo reads much better
ocr.note.limits: Korean and Japanese are not supported yet (no model). Printed Latin script works. The model is fetched only when you turn it on, and the photo never leaves your browser.
